description: This file defines the Surveys class for SuiteCRM, extending Basic, including properties for survey attributes, methods for saving surveys and options, and implementing ACL interface.

classes.name: Surveys
classes.description: Represents the Surveys module, handling survey data, questions, options, and related operations.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the class implements a specific interface, here supporting 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the survey and associated questions and options based on request data.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves options for a survey question, handling creation, deletion, and ordering.

methods.name: getMatrixOptions
methods.description: Returns default or custom matrix options for survey responses.

methods.name: getSubmitText
methods.description: Returns the submit button text, defaulting to 'Submit'.
